 Right Arrow OutKick Sports Multiple Bigfoot sightings reported by gamers who have gotten their hands on 'GTA VI'
 The cryptid, known locally as the 'Skunk Ape,' knocks players unconscious with noxious fumes before approaching them
 By
 Sean Joseph Fox News 
 Published
 November 18, 2026 7:00pm EST Comments 
 Facebook
 Twitter 
 Threads
 Flipboard 
 Print 
 Email 
 Add Fox News on Google 
 close Video Why this software engineer is taking a week off work to play GTA VI 
 Software engineer Edward ‘Bud’ Burress discusses the highly anticipated release of GTA VI, what it means for the gaming community and parents’ concerns on ‘Fox & Friends Weekend.’
 Bigfoot is real and the multiple sightings being reported on social media have video evidence to substantiate those claims. I'm talking, of course, about the presence of the cryptid, or Skunk Ape as it is reportedly referred to, in "GTA VI."
 As "Grand Theft Auto VI" rolls out worldwide on November 19, 2026, and receives high marks , gamers are documenting different aspects of the game. You can go jet-skiing with a dog. You can get busted for stealing an old lady's scooter .
 A billboard for the video game "Grand Theft Auto VI" is pictured above Hollywood Boulevard on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026, in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello) 
 There are even encounters with wildlife that don't always work out in your character's favor. I've seen tiger attacks and people get eaten by an alligator .
 THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! 
 That takes me to the rabbit hole I went down this afternoon on Twitter. The Bigfoot encounters , of which there are many, appear to be taking place in and around the woods of Leonida, reports Game Spot .
 Some players have ended up being knocked out in the woods by a noxious fumes-emitting effigy . As they drift into unconsciousness, Bigfoot's enormous feet can be seen approaching them.
 Promotional displays and storefronts in The Hague, Netherlands, showcase anticipation for Grand Theft Auto VI on Nov. 18, 2026, as the highly anticipated open-world blockbuster takes over retail stores ahead of its global midnight release. (Anadolu via Getty Images) 
 Bigfoot has been everywhere these days. It only stands to reason that the folklore legend would show up in one of the most highly anticipated games ever.
 REDDIT'S BIRDING COMMUNITY GOES WILD AS UNIQUE 'GRAND THEFT AUTO 6' FEATURE COMES TO LIGHT 
 I haven’t purchased the game, therefore I won't be in the reported group of about 1 in 5 salaried employees who are taking time off from work to play "GTA VI" as soon as it comes out.
 Prior to the Bigfoot sightings , I admit that I was planning on purchasing "Grand Theft Auto VI" at some point.
 Stock image of a Bigfoot statue or costume. (Getty Images) 
 OUTKICK IS NOW ON THE FOX APP: CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD 
 Now that you can, among everything else, spend some time in the woods getting abducted by Bigfoot or whatever happens after you've been knocked out by the smell, that purchase might have to come a little sooner.
 As much fun as running around shirtless creating chaos at airports sounds ( seemingly part of the game ), finding actual evidence of Bigfoot is much more intriguing to me.
 Sean Joseph is a writer for OutKick.
